missing.why: The verse calls Laban 'the son of Nahor', which is the Nahor who is Terah's son; the wording skips a generation, which the son-of convention allows.

note: No wrong rows: the Laban/Leah/Rachel/Bilhah/Zilpah rows and the Leah-to-Reuben/Levi/Judah rows match the text, and the owner's sibling rows (simeon, levi, judah brother-of reuben) look right. 'servant-of' is not in the listed types but the text supports it, so it is kept; Jacob's nephew relation to Laban (GEN 29:13) and Laban's idiomatic 'my brother' (GEN 29:15) have no listed type and were left out.
